question: Which of the following is a negative impact of globalisation on Indian economy?

options.text: Rise of straight-jacketed approach to leadership styles
Rise in female participation in employment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rise in relative deprivation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• While globalization has brought several advantages to the Indian economy, it has also had its share of negative impacts. Here are some of them: 
 
• **Increased Competition**: Globalization has led to increased competition for domestic industries from multinational corporations. This has made it difficult for some domestic companies to survive and thrive. 
 
• **Job Displacement**: The influx of cheaper imported goods has led to the closure of some domestic industries, resulting in job losses for Indian workers. 
 
• **Exploitation of Labor**: In some sectors, globalization has led to the exploitation of cheap labor in India, with workers being paid low wages and working in poor conditions.<span _ngcontent-ng
